import pytest

@pytest.mark.xfail
def test_a(): ...

@pytest.mark.skip
def test_b(): ...

@pytest.mark.skip()
def test_c(): ...

@pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True)
def test_d(): ...

@pytest.mark.xfail(
    strict=True,
)
def test_e(): ...

def test_f():
    pytest.xfail("known bug, with a reason")

def test_g():
    pytest.skip("with a reason")
